tagline: Beneath Tommaso's gruff exterior lies a soul profoundly committed to the concrete over the abstract
bio:
## HOW OTHERS SEE ME

I am Tommaso Morosini, and Venice sees a contradiction walking her bridges—a nobleman with hammer-scarred hands and sawdust in my velvet doublet. My shoulders have broadened from years of lifting beams, and my once-soft palms now bear the permanent calluses of a master builder.
